title: Official mongo image (SSPL)
msg: The official mongo image runs MongoDB Community Server. Every Community Server release on or after October 16, 2018, including patch releases of older versions, is under the SSPL. SSPL Section 13: if you make its functionality available to third parties as a service, the Service Source Code of the whole service (management, UI, API, automation, monitoring, backup, storage, hosting) must be published at no charge.
fix: image: ghcr.io/ferretdb/ferretdb:2.7.0 (Apache-2.0), plus a postgres service on ghcr.io/ferretdb/postgres-documentdb:17-0.107.0-ferretdb-2.7.0 and FERRETDB_POSTGRESQL_URL.

title: mongodb/mongodb-community-server image (SSPL)
msg: mongodb/mongodb-community-server is MongoDB Community Server: SSPL for every release on or after October 16, 2018. Offering its functionality to third parties as a service triggers SSPL Section 13.

title: Bitnami MongoDB image or chart (SSPL)
msg: The Bitnami MongoDB image and Helm chart package MongoDB Community Server, so the SSPL (releases on or after October 16, 2018) applies to what they run.

title: mongod server binary or mongodb-org package
msg: This line starts or installs the mongod server (MongoDB Community Server, SSPL). FerretDB is a separate server: its flags and packages are not mongod's.
fix: Run the ferretdb binary or image; configure it with FERRETDB_POSTGRESQL_URL instead of mongod flags.

title: MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_* variables
msg: Only the mongo image reads MONGO_INITDB_ROOT_*. FerretDB authenticates the client's MongoDB URI credentials against the PostgreSQL database, so these variables create no user.
fix: Set POSTGRES_USER / POSTGRES_PASSWORD on the postgres-documentdb container and put the same credentials in FERRETDB_POSTGRESQL_URL.

title: Replica-set bootstrap (--replSet, rs.initiate)
msg: A mongod replica-set bootstrap. replSetInitiate is not in the FerretDB 2.7 compatibility table, and FerretDB stores data in PostgreSQL, so there is no mongod replica set to initiate.
fix: Remove the replica-set bootstrap; get redundancy from the PostgreSQL side (replicate the postgres-documentdb database).

title: Multi-document transaction
msg: FerretDB 2.7 compatibility table: commitTransaction and abortTransaction are "Not implemented yet". Code that relies on a multi-document transaction will fail at commit after the cut-over.
fix: Redesign the write as a single-document update (findAndModify is supported) or keep this workload on a database with transactions until FerretDB implements them.

title: Role management command
msg: Every role management command (createRole, dropRole, updateRole, grantPrivilegesToRole, grantRolesToRole, rolesInfo and the rest) is "Not implemented yet" in FerretDB 2.7.
fix: Drop custom roles from the init script; FerretDB authenticates against PostgreSQL, so manage access there.

title: grantRolesToUser / revokeRolesFromUser
msg: grantRolesToUser and revokeRolesFromUser are "Not implemented yet" in FerretDB 2.7 (createUser, updateUser, dropUser and usersInfo are supported).
fix: Create the user once with createUser; do not change its roles later from the script.

title: convertToCapped / cloneCollectionAsCapped
msg: convertToCapped and cloneCollectionAsCapped are "Not implemented yet" in FerretDB 2.7.
fix: Keep the collection uncapped and trim old documents with a scheduled delete or a TTL-style cleanup job.

title: Client-level bulkWrite command
msg: The bulkWrite server command (client-level bulk write across collections) is "Not implemented yet" in FerretDB 2.7. Collection-level bulkWrite() is sent as insert/update/delete, which are supported.
fix: Call collection.bulkWrite() once per collection instead of client.bulkWrite().

title: killOp
msg: killOp is "Not implemented yet" in FerretDB 2.7 (currentOp is supported), so a watchdog that kills slow operations does nothing.
fix: Cancel the query on the PostgreSQL side (pg_cancel_backend) or stop the client that started it.

title: setParameter
msg: setParameter is "Not implemented yet" in FerretDB 2.7 (getParameter is supported), and mongod --setParameter flags mean nothing to the ferretdb server.
fix: Move the tuning to FerretDB flags/FERRETDB_* variables or to the PostgreSQL configuration.

title: Database profiler
msg: The profile command is "Not implemented yet" in FerretDB 2.7, so setProfilingLevel and --profile collect nothing.
fix: Use explain (supported) per query, or PostgreSQL's own query logging for slow statements.

title: Server admin command FerretDB lacks
msg: logRotate, shutdown, connPoolStats, dropConnections and logApplicationMessage are "Not implemented yet" in FerretDB 2.7; maintenance scripts that call them fail.
fix: Rotate logs and stop the service from the container runtime (docker compose stop, Kubernetes) instead of a database command.

title: X.509 / authenticate command
msg: The authenticate command is "Not implemented yet" in FerretDB 2.7; MONGODB-X509 client-certificate login goes through it. saslStart/saslContinue (SCRAM) are supported.
fix: Use SCRAM username/password in the URI, and keep TLS for the transport.

title: killAllSessionsByPattern
msg: killAllSessionsByPattern is "Not fully implemented yet" in FerretDB 2.7 (killSessions and killAllSessions are supported).
fix: Kill sessions by id with killSessions.

title: FerretDB image without a full tag
msg: The FerretDB docs strongly recommend the full image tag (for example 2.7.0) so FerretDB and the DocumentDB extension stay a matched pair.

title: FerretDB without PostgreSQL + DocumentDB
msg: The FerretDB production image does not include PostgreSQL with the DocumentDB extension, and this file never points FerretDB at one.
fix: Add a service on ghcr.io/ferretdb/postgres-documentdb:17-0.107.0-ferretdb-2.7.0 and set FERRETDB_POSTGRESQL_URL=postgres://user:pass@postgres:5432/postgres.
